approval.description: Only after a 403 approval_required: the manager's approval (pap_…) for that action and amount, from POST /approvals; several, comma-separated.
approval.name: X-Approval

branch.description: The branch (uid); without it the report covers every branch allowed.
branch.name: X-Branch-Id

branchRequired.description: The branch (uid) the request acts in.
branchRequired.name: X-Branch-Id

idempotencyKey.description: Up to 255 characters. A retry with the same key and body gets the first response again (Idempotent-Replayed: true); kept 24 hours.
idempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key

ifMatch.description: The ETag of the resource as read ("7"): the change goes ahead only while it still has that version (else 412 precondition_failed).
ifMatch.name: If-Match

tenant.description: The pharmacy (tenant uid) the request acts in.
tenant.name: X-Tenant-Id

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details. `reason` is the stable machine code; `field` the JSON path of the input it is about; other members (RFC 9457 §3.2) carry values for the message, such as `currentVersion`, `action` and `amount`.

info.description: Multi-tenant, multi-branch pharmacy management. Send Authorization: Bearer <token>, X-Tenant-Id and, on branch routes, X-Branch-Id. Successes use the envelope {success, code, message, timestamp, data}; refusals are RFC 9457 problems (application/problem+json) with a stable `reason`. Each operation's x-scope and x-permission say who may call it. The guide is pharmacy-core-docs/contracts/api-v1.md; this document is the complete reference.
info.title: Pharmacy Core API
